issues.description: FR2 is a dead check per validation report (mutation_score shows 0 mutants detected/targeting it), and FR3/FR4 are untested by the mutant set, though the differential run shows FR3/FR4 do correctly fail on the naive baseline. Coverage gap reduces confidence these requirements are robustly verified across a range of mutants.

recommendations: Add a mutant that specifically exercises FR2 (e.g., wrong width or malformed line field) to raise its coverage score above zero, since it currently appears as a dead/untested check.

Add explicit mutants targeting FR3 (missing fsm state) and FR4 (hallucinated identifier) individually, even though the naive baseline exercises both simultaneously, to isolate detection per-requirement in future mutation analysis.
